tour.intro_lead: You're looking at a new way to organize humanity.
tour.intro_body: Every pin on this map is a Governance Operative System (GOS). Unlike traditional governments, a GOS is transparent and auditable — and it runs on the Internet Computer, a decentralized computing network.
tour.intro_join: You can join an existing GOS, or spin up a new one of your own.
tour.globe_body: Realms appear on this 3D map. Click a glowing pin to fly there and open its details.
tour.rail_body: Open the grid / apps button (top left) for tour, Deploy GOS, Infrastructure, and language. Sign in with Internet Identity from the top right.
tour.browse_body: Open the realm browser to search, filter by stage, and scroll the list of registered realms.
tour.panel_body: Search by name or ID, filter by lifecycle stage, sort by users, and pick a realm card to focus it on the map.
tour.assistant_body: Use this tab to open the Realms AI Assistant — your guide to realms, deployments, and governance.
tour.assistant_compose_body: Type a question in the box and press Send, or tap one of the suggested prompts to get started quickly.
tour.stats_body: Realm count, users, locations, stage breakdown, and build version at a glance.
tour.complete_body: That's everything! You're free to explore — spin the globe, browse realms, and ask the assistant anything. Open the Realms menu anytime to replay this tour.

about.title: What is this?
about.body:
You're looking at a new way to organize humanity.

Every pin on this map is a Governance Operative System (GOS). Unlike traditional governments, a GOS is transparent and auditable — and it runs on the Internet Computer, a decentralized computing network (internetcomputer.org).

You can join an existing GOS, or spin up a new one of your own.

assistant.connect_lead: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok are stronger than this built-in helper. Connect one with the same Realms MCP link — or keep using the built-in assistant with nothing connected.
assistant.connect_section_desc: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok with the Realms MCP connector. The built-in assistant keeps working if you skip this.
assistant.connect_detail: Add this Realms MCP URL as a custom connector in {name}. {name} opens a browser, you sign in with Internet Identity, and approve access.
assistant.connect_footnote: The built-in assistant stays available here without connecting anything.
assistant.connect_not_now: Not now — use the built-in assistant
assistant.connect_chatgpt_step1: In ChatGPT: Settings → Connectors → add a custom MCP connector.
assistant.connect_chatgpt_step2: Paste the Realms MCP URL and continue.
assistant.connect_chatgpt_step3: Sign in with Internet Identity and choose read-only or full access.
assistant.connect_claude_step1: In Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
assistant.connect_claude_step2: Paste the Realms MCP URL and continue.
assistant.connect_claude_step3: Sign in with Internet Identity and choose read-only or full access.
assistant.connect_grok_step1: In Grok: Settings → Connectors → add a custom MCP server.
assistant.connect_grok_step2: Paste the Realms MCP URL and continue.
assistant.connect_grok_step3: Sign in with Internet Identity and choose read-only or full access.
